resources.string: Verify your email
Your account exists. Verify your inbox using the email link, then recheck here. Verification confirms inbox control, not enrollment or employee authorization.
Authorization pending
Your account is waiting for authorization. Your student profile has not been saved. Email verification alone does not confirm enrollment or employee access.
Profile unavailable
Your account profile cannot currently be verified. Live access is unavailable. You can retry or use the separate Demo Mode.
Live features unavailable
This stage does not connect live role features. Demo Mode is a separate preview using local sample data.
